item: R742: an encryption that stops after the library is finished, never stranded
key_paths: src/database/at_rest_state.py src/database/encrypt_tool.py src/api/unlock.py src/api/main.py src/static/app-backup.js tests/test_encrypt_partial_r742.py
summary: The key is held once the library is ciphertext; later stores fail one by one into a pending list read from file headers (never complete while any is plaintext); the encrypt route resumes under the same passphrase and the next unlock finishes the rest; a store is recorded only after it reads back with the key; the replaced plaintext file is overwritten through crypto-erase; Settings and the doctor show the whole set and name plaintext snapshots still on disk; x12.
